Package neqsim.process.equipment.reactor

Class AqueousHydrogenSulfideOxidationElementalSulfurAllocation

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.reactor.AqueousHydrogenSulfideOxidationElementalSulfurAllocation
public final class AqueousHydrogenSulfideOxidationElementalSulfurAllocation extends Object
Creates an explicit, non-mutating elemental-sulfur allocation scenario from one qualified aqueous H2S/O2 sulfur-equivalent segment budget.

The caller supplies the allocation fraction and a basis identifier. This class does not provide a default fraction, qualify the caller's basis, infer a product yield, create S8, or mutate a process model. The unallocated sulfur-equivalent remainder is retained so downstream accounting can avoid applying the same sulfur twice.
